h1: Wienglakor Hotel — A Lanna Teakwood Hotel in Central Lampang with a Garden Waterfall and Koi Pond
intro: If you come to Lampang wanting a city-centre hotel with genuine Lanna character rather than a plain modern box, Wienglakor Hotel is the name that keeps coming up in reviews · A 4-star hotel where teakwood floors, doors and cabinets give the rooms a warm, craftsman feel, with a Lanna-decorated lobby many guests say looks like a heritage hotel, and a garden waterfall and koi pond that light up beautifully at night · It sits in the Suandok area on Phaholyothin Road, easy to get around from, close to the mall and the city centre, with free parking and breakfast included · From approx. ฿1,000/night · Score 8.3 — this place sells atmosphere, location and value rather than glossy newness.

body.html: The first thing guests mention is the lobby and the teakwood work · You walk in to a Lanna-decorated lobby with high ceilings, carved wood and detailing that feels more like a heritage hotel than a typical city property · Many international reviews use the phrase "looks heritage hotel" and praise it as a place with real character, not a generic box.

There are around 100 rooms, from the Classic Room up to Connecting Rooms and an Executive Suite · The signature touch is teakwood floors, doors and cabinets, which make the rooms warm and give them a craftsman charm; rooms are reasonably spacious, the beds are comfortable, and overall they are clean · At the same time, it is honestly an older hotel — many reviews call the rooms "dated", meaning the furnishings and bathrooms feel of an earlier era, even though they are clean and functional · A few reviews note missing hair dryers or irons in some rooms, so it is worth asking the front desk to add them.
"The lobby and gardens are lovely, with a koi pond and a small waterfall. Staff were friendly and helpful, the teakwood rooms feel warm, and it's great value for a hotel in central Lampang."

The other star here is the garden with its waterfall and koi pond · The garden has a small waterfall and a koi pond that, with lighting, looks just as lovely at night as in the daytime · Around it are dining salas in several sizes, both air-conditioned rooms and open-air pavilions, and the restaurant serves Thai food with vegetarian options · Eating in the garden is something families and couples particularly enjoy · This is the part that makes the hotel feel greener and more relaxing than its star count suggests.

Location is a clear strength · The hotel is in the Suandok area on Phaholyothin Road, central Lampang, close to the mall, restaurants and the city centre, with easy onward travel · It has free on-site parking — rare for a city-centre hotel — and offers complimentary pick-up from Lampang train station for those arriving by rail · Many reviews say the location is convenient yet quiet enough, not right on a busy road, making it a good base for exploring the city, walking Kad Kong Ta, visiting Wat Phra That Lampang Luang, and taking a horse-carriage ride around town.

Things to know before booking · First, breakfast gets mixed reviews — many say the choices are limited and the taste is average, so if you take breakfast seriously you may want to head into town for khao soi or coffee · Second, it is an older hotel where the rooms and bathrooms feel of an earlier era, so if you expect crisp, brand-new finishes this may not be it · Third, some reviews mention faint music from a nearby pub or disco carrying until late, and laundry charges that are on the high side, so check prices before using the service.

Prices start at around ฿1,000/night for a Classic Room in normal periods, rising with room type and season to roughly ฿1,800–฿2,500 for a suite or peak dates · The overall score sits at 8.3 from 45 reviews on Trip.com, with Tripadvisor ranking it around #9 of 33 hotels in Lampang · The numbers reflect a city-centre hotel that is good value, strong on atmosphere and service, with the trade-off being the age of the rooms.

In short, Wienglakor Hotel suits travellers and families who want to stay in central Lampang for a little over ฿1,000 and value Lanna atmosphere, a leafy garden, a great location and free parking more than brand-new rooms · If you come to Lampang to explore the city, ride a horse carriage, walk Kad Kong Ta and want a hotel with genuine character, it is a good fit · But if you need crisp new rooms, a swimming pool, or a modern boutique style, consider somewhere like The Space Hotel or a newer boutique in the old town instead.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a room facing the garden or koi pond — it is the best view in the hotel — and come sit in the garden in the evening when the lighting is on · If you are a light sleeper, request a room away from the side that may catch music · Arriving by car is easiest thanks to the free parking, while rail travellers can arrange the station pick-up in advance.

honestSummary: Wienglakor Hotel is a 4-star Lanna-style hotel in central Lampang that stands out for its atmosphere, lobby, garden waterfall and koi pond, teakwood detailing, location and free parking · Around 100 rooms, prices from a little over ฿1,000, near the mall and train station · But you have to accept it is an older hotel where the rooms and bathrooms feel dated, the breakfast is average, and there is no swimming pool.
honestChecks: If you expect crisp new rooms and modern bathrooms — this is an older hotel where the rooms look dated, though clean and functional → if newness matters, choose The Space Hotel or a newly opened boutique instead.
If you need a swimming pool — the hotel has only a hot tub, no pool → if a pool is essential, pick a riverside or suburban resort on the Wang River instead.
If you are a light sleeper — some reviews catch faint pub music until late → request a room away from the side that may carry sound, and bring earplugs just in case.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Wienglakor Hotel Lampang

faq.q: Where is Wienglakor Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is at 138/35 Phaholyothin Road, Suandok, Mueang Lampang in central Lampang · Close to the mall and city centre, about 5 minutes' drive from Lampang train station with complimentary station pick-up · Around 10 minutes' drive from Lampang Airport (LPT) · Arriving by car is convenient thanks to free on-site parking.

faq.q: How much does Wienglakor Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿1,000/night for a Classic Room · Family Connecting Rooms are about ฿1,500 · the Executive Suite around ฿2,000, rising to roughly ฿2,500 in high season · Prices depend on the period, so compare platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Wienglakor Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers and families who want to stay in central Lampang for a little over ฿1,000 and value Lanna atmosphere, a leafy garden, a great location and free parking · A good base for exploring the city · Not ideal for those who want crisp new rooms or a swimming pool.

faq.q: Does Wienglakor Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool · The hotel has only a hot tub · Its common-area highlight is the garden waterfall and koi pond, with dining salas in the garden · If a pool is essential, choose a Wang River-side or suburban resort instead.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Wienglakor Hotel old, and are they clean?
faq.a: It is a long-established hotel · Many reviews say the rooms and bathrooms feel dated but are clean and functional · The highlight is the teakwood floors and decor that give a warm feel · Some rooms may lack a hair dryer or iron, which the front desk can add.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Wienglakor Hotel?
faq.a: Breakfast is a buffet included in the room rate · Reviews are mixed — many say the choices are limited and the taste is average · Since the hotel is central, if you take breakfast seriously you can easily head into town for khao soi or a coffee shop.
